dedupe_keys.name: buenos aires urban code data land use buildable volumes listed buildings

description: Subsecretaría de Planeamiento, Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires publishes the data of the Código Urbanístico of Buenos Aires, which replaced the Urban Planning Code: land use, buildings, structures and installations, subdivision, buildable volumes and urban fabric, with annexes that include the list of catalogued (listed) buildings, special areas and building-and-use plates. Coverage: the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina; regulations in force as of 12 December 2024; the portal lists a four-year revision cycle and the record was last modified on 2026-06-24. Format and access: PDF, CSV, GEOJSON, XLSX, ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-2.5-AR; cost: free. Caveats: the annexes are PDFs and only the tabular and geographic files are machine-readable; the information changes whenever the regulation changes, and the portal notes this. Simulation uses: zoning and buildable-capacity inputs for urban growth and housing-supply models, and exposure scenarios that depend on permitted building height and use. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: Buenos Aires: Urban Code data (land use, buildable volumes, listed buildings)
